theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (D P Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) (d : Fin m → R), IsUnit P → IsUnit Q → P * D * Q = Matrix.diagonal d → Nonempty (((Fin m → R) ⧸ LinearMap.range (Matrix.mulVecLin D)) ≃ₗ[R] ((i : Fin m) → R ⧸ Ideal.span ({d i} : Set R)))
